facts.businessType: Small coastal guesthouse with nine rooms
facts.businessDescription: Casa Luz de Sal is a nine-room guesthouse above a quiet cove on the southern Portuguese coast. Rooms are simple and light-filled, breakfast is served at one long table, and the terrace looks over the Atlantic. The house is adults-only and most guests come to swim, read and eat well rather than tour.
facts.idealClientProfile: Adult couples and solo travelers seeking a quiet coastal stay without resort entertainment; many are repeat off-season visitors. Website purpose: direct room enquiries and bookings.
extraInformation: Positioning: unhurried, salt-washed, personal. Supporting message: nine rooms, one long breakfast table, the Atlantic at the door.

What the guesthouse offers (exactly these four): Rooms — nine light-filled rooms, some with sea-facing balconies, no televisions. Breakfast table — one long shared table each morning with local bread, fruit, eggs and pastries. Terrace & pool — a shaded terrace, a small saltwater pool and steps down to the cove path. Boat coves & walks — the host keeps a hand-drawn map of quiet coves, cliff walks and the fish market timings.
Practical notes the site may state: adults-only; check-in from 15:00; the cove is a three-minute walk; closed December to February.
Things to emphasize: the light, the quiet, the single long table, walking the cove path at dawn.
Strict content constraints: do not invent guest reviews, ratings, press mentions, awards, room prices, availability claims or any statistics.

creativeDirection.direction: Salt-bleached Mediterranean postcard: whitewashed plaster surfaces with cobalt and sea-glass accents, airy full-bleed coastal photography, wide margins like a loosely printed travel journal, and one recurring hand-drawn map motif
creativeDirection.audience: Adult couples and solo travelers 30-65 who prefer quiet coves and long breakfasts to resorts
creativeDirection.conversionGoal: Direct booking enquiry for a stay
creativeDirection.serviceEnvironment: A whitewashed house above a Portuguese cove: salt air, limestone, strong midday light, blue water
creativeDirection.preferredPalette: Whitewash #F8F6F0, cobalt #2456A6, sea glass #9FBFAE, terracotta #C97B4A, ink navy #1E2A3A
creativeDirection.visualStyle: Loose travel-journal editorial: full-bleed photography interrupted by small hand-set notes, the hand-drawn map as a signature section divider, oversized lowercase headlines
creativeDirection.tone: Calm, warm, personal; like a note from the host
creativeDirection.avoidances: No resort-generic sliders, no star ratings, no booking-engine widgets look, no busy gradients, no corporate stock imagery of sunsets with lens flares
creativeDirection.inspirationNotes: Fishing-boat paint jobs, hand-painted ceramic number plates, salt-crusted limestone steps
